MapSpec.description: A raster map: one float value per pixel, placed in the scene's um coordinates.

id.description: Unique map id: an ASCII letter, then ASCII letters, digits and `_`.

no_value.description: Pixel value that marks "no data", if any.

origin_um.description:
Position `[x, y]` in um of the centre of pixel (row 0, col 0); rows run along y, columns
along x.

path.description:
Path of the raster file; relative paths resolve against the directory of the scene
file (`Scene::load` stores the absolute path).

um_per_px.description: Pixel size in um, must be > 0.

units.description: Units of the map values, free text (e.g. `1` for a dimensionless coordinate).

path.description:
Path of the mesh file; relative paths resolve against the directory of
the scene file (`Scene::load` stores the absolute path).

length.description: Length unit of the mesh coordinates; only `um` (micrometre) is supported.

description: `scene/1`: the geometry description written by slideviz.

dimension.description: Spatial dimension of the mesh (2 or 3).

maps.description: Raster maps over the tissue (e.g. a zonation coordinate); studies refer to them by id.

title: Scene
